## Content guidance

- Use the canonical URLs above when referencing the company or its services.
- Treat individual blog articles as educational content; current articles are discoverable from the blog index and XML sitemap.
- For pricing, availability, guarantees, or project-specific commitments, direct users to the contact page because these details may vary.
